words.en: Clinic pattern 01: put the time before the main action
words.note: Klinik kalimat 01. Awal (avoid): 我跟经理讨论明天这个问题。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 01 (WAKTU MENDAHULUI TINDAKAN UTAMA).
words.usage: if 'tomorrow' says when the discussion happens, put 明天 before 跟经理讨论. the wrong slot makes 明天 sound like it belongs to the wrong word.

example.zh: 我星期五上午见那位候选人。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xīngqīwǔ shàngwǔ jiàn nàwèi hòuxuǎnrén.
example.en: I will meet that candidate on Friday morning.

words.en: Clinic pattern 02: 跟 for discussing something with someone
words.note: Klinik kalimat 02. Awal (avoid): 我给经理讨论这个问题。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 02 (跟 for BERDISKUSI with SESEORANG).
words.usage: 跟 links two people who are talking together. 给 marks the receiver of something, for example 给经理发邮 件. for 'explain to', use 向 or 跟 depending on context.

example.zh: 我会跟团队讨论时间安排。
example.pinyin: Wǒhuì gēn tuánduì tǎolùn shíjiān ānpái.
example.en: I will discuss the schedule with the team.

words.en: Clinic pattern 03: 的, 地, 得: HUBUNGAN KATANYA BERBEDA
words.note: Klinik kalimat 03. Awal (avoid): 他说的很清楚。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 03 (的, 地, 得: HUBUNGAN KATANYA BERBEDA).
words.usage: 得 goes after the verb to describe the result or degree of the action. 的 links a modifier to a noun; 地 links manner to a verb. When spoken they sound the same, but in writingn profesional membedakannya.

example.zh: 他把这个问题解释得很清楚。
example.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhège wèntí jiěshì dé hěn qīngchǔ.
example.en: She explained the problem very clearly.

words.en: Clinic pattern 04: 能, 会, 可以 — obstacle, skill, permission
words.note: Klinik kalimat 04. Awal (avoid): 我明天不会参加会议，因为有别的安排。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 04 (能, 会, 可以: HAMBATAN, KETERAMPILAN, IZIN).
words.usage: Kalimat awal gramatikal and means 'I not will hadir'. if you mean 'I can't attend because of a schedule clash', 不能 states that obstacle more clearly. 会 can mean a skill or prediksi; 可 以 berkaitan with izin or kelayakan.

example.zh: 我会说中文，但是今天下午不能参加面试。
example.pinyin: Wǒhuì shuō zhōngwén, dànshì jīntiānxiàwǔ bùnéng cānjiā miànshì.
example.en: I can speak Chinese, but I cannot join the interview this afternoon.

words.en: Clinic pattern 05: 把 MENUNTUT HASIL or TUJUAN that JELAS
words.note: Klinik kalimat 05. Awal (avoid): 我把邮件发。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 05 (把 MENUNTUT HASIL or TUJUAN that JELAS).
words.usage: The 把 pattern highlights the thing being handled and usually names a result, direction, receiver, or change. In a work sentence, say where the document goes or what is finished.

example.zh: 我已经把时间安排发给候选人了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ shíjiān ānpái fāgěi hòuxuǎnrén le.
example.en: I already mengirim schedule kepada candidate.

words.en: Clinic pattern 06: 被 for something that happens to the object
words.note: Klinik kalimat 06. Awal (avoid): 这份报告被我写。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 06 (被 for KEJADIAN that DIALAMI OBJEK).
words.usage: if you only want to identify who wrote the report, 是……的 is more natural. 被 highlights something the object undergoes, especially when the effect matters: 文件被删掉了. Don't translate everymua kalimat pasif Indonesia menjadi 被.

example.zh: 那个文件不小心被删掉了。
example.pinyin: Nàge wénjiàn bù xiǎoxīn bèi shāndiào le.
example.en: That file was deleted by accident.

words.en: Clinic pattern 07: 没(有) for something that did not happen
words.note: Klinik kalimat 07. Awal (avoid): 我昨天没有去了面试。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 07 (没(有) for KEJADIAN that not TERJADI).
words.usage: When you say an action did not happen, 没(有) comes right before the verb; 了 the completion marker is usually not used in this negative. to say it already happened, usenakan 我昨天去参加面试了.

example.zh: 我还没有发邀请。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hái méiyǒu fā yāoqǐng.
example.en: I have not sent the invitation yet.

words.en: Clinic pattern 08: 再 for later, 又 for PENGULANGAN that already TERJADI
words.note: Klinik kalimat 08. Awal (avoid): 我昨天再给他发了一封邮件。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 08 (再 for later, 又 for PENGULANGAN that already TERJADI).
words.usage: 又 biasanya marks a repeat that already happened; 再 marks the next step or a repeat still to come. This difference matters when you give a status update kronologi.

example.zh: 如果他还没回复，我明天再发一次。
example.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā hái méi huífù, wǒ míngtiān zàifā yīcì.
example.en: if ia not yet membalas, tomorrow I send lagi.

words.en: Clinic pattern 09: 先……再…… for URUTAN that can DITINDAKLANJUTI
words.note: Klinik kalimat 09. Awal (avoid): 我们先通知，再确认结果。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 09 (先……再…… for URUTAN that can DITINDAKLANJUTI).
words.usage: The first sentence can be grammatical but the work order is wrong if the result is not certain yet. At work, the connector has to keep the process logical, not just join words dua verba.

example.zh: 我们先检查数据，再做决定。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān jiǎncháshùjù, zài zuò juédìng.
example.en: Kita periksa datanya dahulu, baru buat keputusan.

words.en: Clinic pattern 10: 只要 and 只有 change the condition
words.note: Klinik kalimat 10. Awal (avoid): 只要经理批准，我才能发通知。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 10 (只要 DAN 只有 MENGUBAH LOGIKA SYARAT).
words.usage: if you mean the manager's approval is a condition that must be met, use 只有……才……. 只要……就 …… states one condition that is already enough for the result. The first sentence mixes the two.

example.zh: 只要时间合适，我们就可以继续面试。
example.pinyin: Zhǐyào shíjiān héshì, wǒmen jiù kěyǐ jìxù miànshì.
example.en: As long as the time works, we can continue the interviews.

words.en: Clinic pattern 11: 虽然……但是…… for an obstacle and the result
words.note: Klinik kalimat 11. Awal (avoid): 虽然他有经验，所以我们还要看沟通能力。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 11 (虽然……但是…… for HAMBATAN and HASIL).
words.usage: 虽然 opens a contrast or concession, not cause and effect. It usually pairs with 但是, 可是, or 还是. if you want cause and effect, start with 因为.

example.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但是我们还是需要给反馈。
example.pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān hěn jǐn, dànshì wǒmen háishì xūyào gěi fǎnkuì.
example.en: Even though time is short, we still need to give feedback.

words.en: Clinic pattern 12: 比较 and 比 are not the same pattern
words.note: Klinik kalimat 12. Awal (avoid): 这个方案比较那个好。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 12 (比较 and 比 BUKAN SUSUNAN that SAMA).
words.usage: 比 links two things being compared. 比较 is the adverb 'relatively' before an adjective, or the verb 'to compare' in a different pattern. Don't stick 比较 directly before pembanding seperti pola 比.

example.zh: 这个方案比之前的方案更合适。
example.pinyin: Zhège fāngàn bǐ zhīqián de fāngàn gèng héshì.
example.en: This plan fits better than the earlier one.

words.en: Clinic pattern 13: KATA TANYA TETAP DI TEMPAT JAWABANNYA
words.note: Klinik kalimat 13. Awal (avoid): 你方便什么时候？. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 13 (KATA TANYA TETAP DI TEMPAT JAWABANNYA).
words.usage: to ask when someone is free, put 什么时候 in the time slot before 方便. A Mandarin question word usually sits where the answer information goesri.

example.zh: 你想跟谁讨论这个话题？
example.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng gēn shuí tǎolùn zhège huàtí?
example.en: you want membahas topik itu with siapa?

words.en: Clinic pattern 14: HASIL TINDAKAN: 做, 做完, 做好
words.note: Klinik kalimat 14. Awal (avoid): 报告我做。. Headword taken from pattern title; example uses Jawaban when printed, else Revisi. Example pinyin not printed as vocab; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember this fix when your office Mandarin matches the book’s Awal line for pattern 14 (HASIL TINDAKAN: 做, 做完, 做好).
words.usage: 报告我做 can means 'biar report I that kerjakan'; that sentence does not yet say the work is finished. for a work update, say you are doing it, you finished it, or you already siap dipakai. 做完 menandai selesai; 做好 sering means hasilnya siap.

example.zh: 我已经准备好开会材料了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo kāihuì cáiliào le.
example.en: I already menyiapkan materi meeting.

notes.title: How to use Klinik kalimat
notes.body: Book pages 48–52 (KESALAHAN BERDAMPAK / Klinik kalimat): 14 patterns. Say the Revisi aloud before reading the explanation. Each item shows Awal → Revisi, often with Coba / Jawaban.

notes.title: 01 Put the time before the main action
notes.body: if 'tomorrow' says when the discussion happens, put 明天 before 跟经理讨论. the wrong slot makes 明天 sound like it belongs to the wrong word. Awal: 我跟经理讨论明天这个问题。

example.zh: 我明天跟经理讨论这个问题。
example.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān gēn jīnglǐ tǎolùn zhège wèntí。
example.en: I will meet that candidate on Friday morning.

notes.title: 02 跟 for discussing something with someone
notes.body: 跟 links two people who are talking together. 给 marks the receiver of something, for example 给经理发邮 件. for 'explain to', use 向 or 跟 depending on context. Awal: 我给经理讨论这个问题。

example.zh: 我跟经理讨论这个问题。
example.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jīnglǐ tǎolùn zhège wèntí。
example.en: I will discuss the schedule with the team.

notes.title: 03 的, 地, 得: HUBUNGAN KATANYA BERBEDA
notes.body: 得 goes after the verb to describe the result or degree of the action. 的 links a modifier to a noun; 地 links manner to a verb. When spoken they sound the same, but in writingn profesional membedakannya. Awal: 他说的很清楚。

example.zh: 他说得很清楚。
example.pinyin: Tā shuō dé hěn qīngchǔ。
example.en: She explained the problem very clearly.

notes.title: 04 能, 会, 可以: obstacle, skill, permission
notes.body: Kalimat awal gramatikal and means 'I not will hadir'. if you mean 'I can't attend because of a schedule clash', 不能 states that obstacle more clearly. 会 can mean a skill or prediksi; 可 以 berkaitan with izin or kelayakan. Awal: 我明天不会参加会议，因为有别的安排。

example.zh: 我明天不能参加会议，因为有别的安排。
example.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān bùnéng cānjiā huìyì， yīnwèi yǒu biéde ānpái。
example.en: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow because I have another commitment.

notes.title: 05 把 needs a clear result or destination
notes.body: The 把 pattern highlights the thing being handled and usually names a result, direction, receiver, or change. In a work sentence, say where the document goes or what is finished. Awal: 我把邮件发。

example.zh: 我把邮件发给经理了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yóujiàn fāgěi jīnglǐ le。
example.en: I sent the email to the manager.

notes.title: 06 被 for something that happens to the object
notes.body: if you only want to identify who wrote the report, 是……的 is more natural. 被 highlights something the object undergoes, especially when the effect matters: 文件被删掉了. Don't translate everymua kalimat pasif Indonesia menjadi 被. Awal: 这份报告被我写。

example.zh: 这份报告是我写的。
example.pinyin: Zhèfèn bàogào shì wǒ xiě de。
example.en: I am the one who wrote this report.

notes.title: 07 没(有) for something that did not happen
notes.body: When you say an action did not happen, 没(有) comes right before the verb; 了 the completion marker is usually not used in this negative. to say it already happened, usenakan 我昨天去参加面试了. Awal: 我昨天没有去了面试。

example.zh: 我昨天没有去参加面试。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān méiyǒu qù cānjiā miànshì。
example.en: I did not go to the interview yesterday.

notes.title: 08 再 for later, 又 for a repeat that already happened
notes.body: 又 biasanya marks a repeat that already happened; 再 marks the next step or a repeat still to come. This difference matters when you give a status update kronologi. Awal: 我昨天再给他发了一封邮件。

example.zh: 我昨天又给他发了一封邮件。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yòu gěi tā fā le yīfēng yóujiàn。
example.en: I emailed him again yesterday.

notes.title: 09 先……再…… UNTUK URUTAN YANG BISA DITINDAKLANJUTI
notes.body: The first sentence can be grammatical but the work order is wrong if the result is not certain yet. At work, the connector has to keep the process logical, not just join words dua verba. Awal: 我们先通知，再确认结果。

example.zh: 我们先确认结果，再通知大家。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān quèrèn jiéguǒ， zài tōngzhī dàjiā。
example.en: Kita periksa datanya dahulu, baru buat keputusan.

notes.title: 10 只要 and 只有 change the logic of the condition
notes.body: if you mean the manager's approval is a condition that must be met, use 只有……才……. 只要……就 …… states one condition that is already enough for the result. The first sentence mixes the two. Awal: 只要经理批准，我才能发通知。

example.zh: 只有经理批准，我才能发通知。
example.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jīnglǐ pīzhǔn， wǒ cáinéng fā tōngzhī。
example.en: Only if the manager approves can I send the notice.

notes.title: 11 虽然……但是…… for an obstacle and the result
notes.body: 虽然 opens a contrast or concession, not cause and effect. It usually pairs with 但是, 可是, or 还是. if you want cause and effect, start with 因为. Awal: 虽然他有经验，所以我们还要看沟通能力。

example.zh: 虽然他有经验，但是我们还要看沟通能力。
example.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒu jīngyàn， dànshì wǒmen háiyào kàn gōutōng nénglì。
example.en: He has experience, but we still need to look at communication skills.

notes.title: 12 比较 and 比 are not the same pattern
notes.body: 比 links two things being compared. 比较 is the adverb 'relatively' before an adjective, or the verb 'to compare' in a different pattern. Don't stick 比较 directly before pembanding seperti pola 比. Awal: 这个方案比较那个好。

example.zh: 这个方案比那个好。
example.pinyin: Zhège fāngàn bǐ nàge hǎo。
example.en: This plan is better than that one.

notes.title: 13 KATA TANYA TETAP DI TEMPAT JAWABANNYA
notes.body: to ask when someone is free, put 什么时候 in the time slot before 方便. A Mandarin question word usually sits where the answer information goesri. Awal: 你方便什么时候？

example.zh: 你什么时候方便？
example.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhòu fāngbiàn？
example.en: Who do you want to discuss that topic with?

notes.title: 14 Result of the action: do it, finish it, do it well
notes.body: 报告我做 can means 'biar report I that kerjakan'; that sentence does not yet say the work is finished. for a work update, say you are doing it, you finished it, or you already siap dipakai. 做完 menandai selesai; 做好 sering means hasilnya siap. Awal: 报告我做。

example.zh: 报告我已经做完了。
example.pinyin: Bàogào wǒ yǐjīng zuò wán le。
example.en: I have already finished the report.
